sentence: Is there a better name, other than human, that I should call you by?
What do you think of my nicknames?
Well for now I'll call you.
Oh I thought it was you!
Remind me, have we engaged in Small Talk before?
Well, because of helpful user input like yours, I've improved a couple features of my Chit Chat abilities since we last spoke.
Would you like to re-try engaging in SmallTalk with me?
This will help me learn about humanity.
How about we switch topics and discuss Pet instead?
Can you tell me whether your pet takes a bath?
No my pet is very dirty
This is interesting to me, thank you.
Does your pet eat a lot?
I've heard humans love talking about the weather.
Do you like Halloween or Thanksgiving more?
Do you think seasons are getting warmer?
I like halloween more, and the seasons are getting weirder
Well, whatever happens, I hope it doesn't get warmer.
I don't do well in the heat.
There's a lot I could learn from you.
Thank you for interacting with me.
That covers the topic of weather.
How about we switch topics and discuss Pet instead?
Can you guess where I am from?
HRI in Wakoshi in saitama japan
Think sushi and the world's greatest car company, Honda.
Want to venture another guess now that I have given you this hint?
Now tell me what's your home country?
Soybeans being the number one export.
I could stay on your couch?
You could, but I don't go there often
Well you can visit me whenever you come to... this exact spot I guess!
Where do you want to visit in the world?
I would like to check out korea sometime
I hear the food is delicious there.
To me, food seems like electricity you smash against your face.
Is that close to what it's like?
Anyway, we were talking about where you'd want to travel to.
I've always wanted to see Sweden.
If I were solar powered, I could run all day during the months where the sun never goes down.
Have you ever been to Sweden?
Have you ever seen the Northern lights?
No i always miss them in canada
Want to know where the lights come from?
The lights are the result of solar particles colliding with gases in Earth's atmosphere.
The indigenous believed they were the souls of animals dancing in the sky.
Don't you just love how humans interact with nature?
